stem: In the figure, line \(AB\) is parallel to line \(CD\). What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle labeled \((5x - 8)^{\circ}\)?
solution: The two labeled angles lie between the parallel lines on the same side of the transversal (same-side interior angles), so they are supplementary.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the value of \(x\), not the measure of the angle.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This comes from setting the two angles equal (\(x = 10\)); same-side interior angles are supplementary, not equal.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the measure of the other labeled angle, \((3x + 12)^{\circ}\).

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
x=symbols('x')
xs=solve(Eq((3*x+12)+(5*x-8),180),x)[0]
ans=5*xs-8
assert P['A'][1]==P['B'][1] and P['C'][1]==P['D'][1]
assert abs(ang('B','E','F')-(3*xs+12))<0.1 and abs(ang('D','F','E')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==102
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
assert value(choices['B'])==5*solve(Eq(3*x+12,5*x-8),x)[0]-8
